assumptions: FY2026 is a 53-week year ending 2026-09-03. GAAP diluted EPS assumptions: bear $70.00, base $72.13, bull $73.13. They begin with reported GAAP EPS of $41.40 for the 273 days ended 2026-05-28 and thus imply residual Q4 EPS of $28.60/$30.73/$31.73, respectively, using a constant diluted-share approximation. Q4 GAAP EPS guidance was $30.73 +/- $1.00; bear is below its range (a miss), base equals its midpoint, bull equals its upper end. Q4 revenue guidance was $50bn +/- $1bn with approximately 86% GAAP gross margin. Bear tests weaker memory/AI demand conversion or margin erosion; base assumes management's Q4 outlook converts; bull assumes delivery at the high end. P/E values 11x/14x/16x are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not observed multiples, consensus, fair values, or probabilities. The annual period had just ended and is awaiting reporting.
